name: Greenvale
description: Lush fertile plains where wheat and vegetables flourish in rich soil.

name: Riverford
description: A bustling river delta, known for thriving fish markets and caravan docks.

name: Silverwood
description: Ancient woodland rich with tall oaks, white pine, and wild game.

name: Stonehaven
description: Rugged rocky bluffs supplying quarry stones and limestone blocks.

name: Ironridge
description: Craggy peaks filled with deep veins of coal, iron, and copper ore.

name: Sunreach Valley
description: Sun-drenched hills ideal for sprawling vineyards, orchards, and livestock.

name: Highcourt
description: The administrative heart of the nobles, where taxes and rents run high.

name: Goldcrest Peaks
description: Gleaming mountain ranges holding deep gold veins and precious gem seams.

name: Frostmere
description: Frigid northern tundra holding rare winter furs, amber, and ice crystals.

name: The Crownlands
description: The sovereign imperial seat, providing immense royal prestige and dominion.
